# hush_resource_server (Resource)

A resource server: an API behind your own gateway that agents get Hush tokens for. A `hush_resource_application` says which agents and users get them, and with which scopes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hush_resource_server" "clientworks" {
  name         = "clientworks"
  display_name = "Clientworks API"
  audience     = "https://api.example.com/clientworks"

  scope {
    name        = "accounts:read"
    description = "Read accounts"
  }
  scope {
    name        = "trades:write"
    description = "Place trades"
  }

  token_lifetime = 900

  token_claim {
    name      = "teams"
    attribute = "groups"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `audience` (String) The API's URI, the `aud` of its tokens, as your gateway checks it. Unique in the organization.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `name` (String) Unique name, used by `hush_resource_application.resource`. Fixed at creation.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `scope` (Block List) A scope the API supports. To drop one an application grants, remove it from the application first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--scope))
- `token_claim` (Block List, Max: 20) A claim added to the API's tokens from the user's profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--token_claim))
- `token_lifetime` (Number) Token lifetime in seconds, 60 to 86400. Default 3600.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope`

Required:

- `name` (String) Scope name, as it appears in the token's `scope`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description.


<a id="nestedblock--token_claim"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_claim`

Required:

- `attribute` (String) The user's attribute: a profile field (e.g. `email`), `groups`, or a claim from the IdP.
- `name` (String) Claim name in the token.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the resource server's name.
terraform import hush_resource_server.clientworks clientworks
```
